rules: ETA is a range unless the propulsion model and subspace conditions justify precision.
Warp speed is not converted to distance with one universal immutable formula.
The route planner must use ship capability, current damage, power state and local subspace conditions.
Crossing a political border can trigger warnings, interception, inspection or diplomatic consequences.
Unknown or unexplored space may hide route risk from the player while World State retains the truth.
AI may explain route options but Core chooses and persists actual traversal state.
